story.iWant: to generate actionable recommendations based on financial data analysis
story.soThat: users receive strategic guidance on where to focus attention

task.title: Design Recommendation data models
task.subtask: 1.1 Define RecommendationCategory enum: COST_REDUCTION, REVENUE_GROWTH, RISK_MITIGATION, OPERATIONAL_EFFICIENCY, STRATEGIC_INVESTMENT
1.2 Define Recommendation model with fields: category, impact_score (1-10), title, description, rationale, supporting_evidence (Dict), action_steps (List[str]), urgency, sources, created_at
1.3 Define RecommendationResult model with fields: recommendations, total_generated, generation_method, insights_analyzed

task.title: Implement generate_recommendations() function
task.subtask: 2.1 Create raglite/insights/recommendations.py module (~80-120 lines)
2.2 Implement signature: async def generate_recommendations(insights: List[Insight], context: Optional[str] = None) -> RecommendationResult
2.3 Implement recommendation categorization logic based on insight type
2.4 Implement impact scoring (1=low impact, 10=high impact)

task.title: Implement LLM-powered recommendation synthesis
task.subtask: 3.1 Implement synthesize_recommendation() helper using Mistral Large

3.4 Include supporting evidence citations from source insights
3.5 Determine urgency level based on insight priority and category

task.title: Implement recommendation prioritization and filtering

4.2 Implement deduplication

4.4 Sort results by impact score descending

task.title: Structured logging and context

5.3 Add timing metrics for performance

task.title: Unit tests

6.2-6.9 Test all models, functions, edge cases - target 80%+ coverage

task.title: Integration tests

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Recommendation engine analyzes insights and generates actionable next steps (FR25) - Unit test: generate_recommendations() accepts List[Insight] and returns List[Recommendation]
Recommendations prioritized by potential impact - Unit test: Recommendation model contains impact_score (1-10), results sorted by impact descending
Recommendations include rationale with supporting data - Unit test: Recommendation model contains rationale string and supporting_evidence dict fields
Recommendation quality validated: align with human expert analysis 80%+ of time - Integration test: validate recommendations against expert-labeled dataset
Example tested: "Focus on reducing cloud infrastructure costs - trending 40% over budget with minimal usage increase" - Integration test with synthetic cloud cost anomaly

dependencies.python:
<package name="pydantic" version=">=2.0,<3.0" purpose="Data models with validation"/>
<package name="pytest-mock" version=">=3.12,<4.0" purpose="Mocking Mistral client"/>

constraints.constraint: Type hints mandatory on all functions
Google-style docstrings on all public functions
Processing time <3s for typical input (5-10 insights)

interface.name: generate_recommendations
interface.signature: async def generate_recommendations(insights: List[Insight], context: Optional[str] = None) -> RecommendationResult
interface.description: Generate strategic recommendations from analyzed insights

interface.name: synthesize_recommendation
interface.signature: async def synthesize_recommendation(insight: Insight) -> tuple[str, str, list[str], str]
interface.description: LLM-powered recommendation synthesis returning (title, rationale, action_steps, urgency)

interface.name: calculate_impact_score
interface.description: Calculate recommendation impact score (1-10) based on insight priority and category

interface.name: categorize_recommendation
interface.description: Map insight category to recommendation category

interface.name: filter_recommendations
interface.signature: def filter_recommendations(recommendations: list[Recommendation], *, category: RecommendationCategory | None = None, min_impact: int | None = None, limit: int | None = None) -> list[Recommendation]
interface.description: Filter and limit recommendations by category, impact threshold, or count

interface.name: Insight
interface.signature: class Insight(BaseModel): category, priority, summary, supporting_data, rationale, sources, recommended_action, created_at
interface.description: Input model from Story 4.7 - recommendations are generated from insights

interface.name: get_mistral_client
interface.description: Singleton Mistral client for LLM reasoning

tests.standards: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Mock external dependencies (Mistral client). Use @pytest.fixture for test data setup. Test file naming: test_*.py. Target 80%+ coverage on new code. Use pytest-mock for client mocking.

ideas.idea: Test generate_recommendations() accepts List[Insight] and returns RecommendationResult with List[Recommendation]
Test empty insights list raises ValueError
Test Recommendation model has impact_score field with ge=1, le=10 constraint
Test results sorted by impact_score descending (highest first)
Test Recommendation model has rationale and supporting_evidence fields
Test synthesize_recommendation() returns title, rationale, action_steps, urgency
Test 80% alignment on expert-labeled dataset (6+ scenarios)
